title: The Backpack That Felt Lighter
intro: This quiz follows Noor and Eli as they learn the difference between mass and weight and why objects weigh less on the Moon.

choices: The force pulling an object downward
The amount of matter in an object
The amount of space around an object
The speed at which an object falls
questions.explanation: Mass is the amount of matter in an object.

choices: The amount of matter in an object
The size of an object
The force of gravity pulling on an object
The temperature of an object
questions.explanation: Weight is the force of gravity pulling on an object.

questions.prompt: What would happen to Noor's backpack on the Moon?
choices: Its mass and weight would both increase
Its mass would decrease, but its weight would stay the same
Its mass would stay the same, but it would weigh less
It would have no mass or weight
questions.explanation: Its mass would stay the same, but it would weigh less on the Moon.

questions.prompt: Why would the backpack feel lighter on the Moon?
choices: The Moon has a weaker gravitational pull than Earth
The backpack would lose some of its books
The Moon has no gravity at all
The air on the Moon would push it upward
questions.explanation: The Moon has a weaker gravitational pull than Earth.

questions.prompt: Which tool is commonly used to measure mass?
choices: A thermometer
A balance or scale
A ruler
A stopwatch
questions.explanation: A balance or scale is commonly used to measure mass.
